verses.1: And the fifth angel sang. We saw a star fall from heaven onto the earth. And he was given the power to cause the fruit of the vine to be destroyed.
verses.2: And the hole in the earth was opened; smoke rose from it, like the smoke from a huge fire. The sun and the air were destroyed by the smoke from that hole.
verses.3: And from the smoke, tiny particles were sent into the earth. They were given the same authority that bees have over the earth.
verses.4: And it was decreed that they should not destroy the soil or any plants, unless those people who do not have the mark of God on their foreheads were also destroyed.
verses.5: And they were given orders not to kill them, but to torture them for five months. Their torture was like that of a scorpion when it stings a person.
verses.6: And on those days, people seek death; they cannot find it. They desire to die, and death flees from them.
verses.7: And the similarities between these warriors are similar to those of horses prepared for war. Their heads were decorated with crowns like gold. Their faces were also similar to human faces.
verses.8: And they had three hairs on their heads, just like women do. And those who touched them were also considered to be women.
verses.9: And they had wings like iron wings. The sound of their wings was like the sound of many horses rushing into battle.
verses.10: And they have antennae that are similar to those of spiders, along with centers. In these antennae, their power lies in being able to harm humans for five months.
verses.11: They have a king’s messenger among them. His name is Hebrew Abadon; in the Greek language, his name is Apollon.
verses.12: One of the ships has already left. Now, two more ships are coming along after that.
verses.13: And the sixth angel was also loud; I heard a voice from the golden altar in front of the God’s face.
verses.14: In response to the messenger’s message, he who had the flute said, “Put those four messengers on the banks of the great river Euphrates.”
verses.15: And the four angels who were prepared for the day and the night and the week and the year were released, so that they might destroy the third part of mankind.
verses.16: And the number of the cavalry units was two million units. I heard that number.
verses.17: And in that way, I saw the horses on the hill, as well as those who sat beside them. They had flames and smoke coming from their mouths. And the heads of the horses resembled those of lions. From their mouths, fire, smoke, and poisonous gases were released.
verses.18: Due to these three kinds of injuries, one-third of the people died. They died from the fire, the smoke, and the poisonous substances that entered their mouths through their nostrils.
verses.19: For the power of horses lies in their mouths and in their hooves. Their hooves are similar to human feet; they have heads, and it is through those hooves that they act unjustly.
verses.20: And the rest of people, who did not suffer from these injuries, also did not stop working with their hands. They did not worship demons and the idols made of gold, silver, copper, stone, or wood. They could neither see them, nor hear them, nor move them at all.
verses.21: And they were not affected by the killings they committed, nor by the drugs they used, nor by their prostitution, nor by the thefts they committed.
